name: Cordis Autofit Dress Oxford
description: A clean, low-profile oxford in burnished synthetic leather with a subtle matte finish. Micro-tensioners embedded in the lacing system read foot pressure and adjust fit throughout the day — tighter during long walks, looser during seated periods. Available in black, oxblood, and slate grey.
functionality: Adaptive auto-lacing that adjusts tension based on activity and swelling patterns tracked via embedded pressure sensors.
what_it_says: You're a professional who invests in comfort without being flashy about it. Practical intelligence, not performance theater.
story_hooks: The lacing sensors log gait data — someone has been accessing that data without the wearer's knowledge.
A contact can be identified by the distinctive pressure signature their auto-lace oxford broadcasts on short-range BCI mesh.
related_entities: Axiom Systems BCI-Integrated Mesh Network Protocol
